title: Invertible normalized oplax data for global section scalar extension
statement: For a sheaf of commutative rings O on a small site, the actual global-section scalar-extension functor admits invertible oplax tensor data whose unit component is exactly ringFamilyGlobalExtensionUnit.

source.place: Tags 0996 and 099E, final tensor base-change paragraph, sectionwise tensor comparison

proof.text: On the bottom-topology one-object site, the sheafification adjunction is an equivalence. Give its right adjoint the induced lax monoidal structure; its unit and tensor maps are invertible. Its inverse unit map is the identity, by the adjunction triangle identity and the defining sheafification unit comparison. Reindex this functor to obtain the constant module presheaf functor and transport its monoidal structure along the identity-on-sections comparison.

Apply the normalized strong monoidal presheaf scalar-extension theorem to evaluation from the constant global ring presheaf to O. Compose the resulting strong monoidal pullback with the constant functor and the existing strong monoidal sheafification.

For the inverse unit map, the constant-functor component is the identity and the sheafification component is its adjunction counit. Apply the two adjunction Hom equivalences. Their naturality and triangle identities reduce the desired equality to the normalized coefficient formula of the presheaf scalar extension. For evaluation this formula is exactly s evaluated at X, which defines ringFamilyGlobalExtensionUnit. Invertibility of all comparison maps follows from the composed strong monoidal structure.

lean.statement:
theorem ringFamilyGlobalExtension_oplax_normalized
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory O
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory
      (CochainComplex.onePointRingSheaf (ringFamilyGlobalRing O))
    ∃ oplax : (ringFamilyGlobalExtension O).OplaxMonoidal,
      IsIso oplax.η ∧ (∀ M N, IsIso (oplax.δ M N)) ∧
        oplax.η = ringFamilyGlobalExtensionUnit O
